DEPARTMENT OF MUSIC
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Ref. No.D./Mus./26/27 Date : 14.01.2026
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the appointment of Junior Technician (Tabla Accompanist)
(G-III)- 1 and Junior Technician Tabla Player (G-III)- 1 on current DC rate purely on
contract basis initially for period of 89 days (extendable as per requirement) against the vacant
post of Jr. Technician Tabla Accompanist G-III and Jr. Technician Tabla Player G-III
QUALIFICATIONS:-
 Post-Graduation with Tabla with 1 year experience in relevant area after post-
graduation.
Or
 Graduation with 55% marks or equivalent grade with Tabla with 3 years
experience in relevant area after graduation.
Or
 10+2 in relevant stream or any other examination equivalent to 10+2 and 3 years
Diploma with 55% marks or equivalent grade in the relevant subject/trade from
recognized Institution and 3 years’ experience in relevant area after
Diploma/certificate course.
The applicants are required to fill the application form attached herewith and submit
the application form duly filled in along with self-attested copies of the academic
testimonials/certificates to the Chairperson, Department of Music, Panjab
University, Chandigarh, PIN 160015 in hard copy format only latest by 27.01.2026
upto 04:00 P:M.
IMPORTANT :
 Mention Mobile Number, Whatsapp Number, Email ID properly on the form to
convey the Interview schedule and any other information time to time.
 Kindly be in touch with following website for further updates.
https://music.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=1
